posts.cooked: Will the OPPE be conducted in unix (ssh iitm ) or in seek portal ?

posts.name: Gurkirat Singh
posts.cooked: We will have to login in both, on portal to share screen and facecam and on vm to solve ques.

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked:
You have to solve the OPPE questions on OPPE vm (similar in design & everything to course vm only difference is that it has a different hostname). Access will be given one week before OPPE and you can do NPPE (mock exam), there to check for any issues.

As Gurkirat mentioned, you have to open the exam portal for the exam duration but there you have to only submit COC and that’s it.
